SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Observing and Articulating signs (listening and speaking) 4.1.1 Naming, part of MY HOME Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learning Experien in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: What do we use at home when cooking? 2. What different activities do we do at home?

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Observing and Articulating signs (listening and speaking) 4.1.1 Naming together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Love: Caring as learner develops attachment to items found at home and demonstrates ownership of the same items.

● Responsibility: Accountability as learner demonstrates good care of different items at home.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Health related issues awareness as learner identifies activities we do to make sure that the home is clean.

● Socio-economic issues as leaner talks about different economic activities done at home.

Link to other Learning Areas: as learners name through songs they integrate music.
